title: VictoriaLogs
description: VictoriaLogs engine health, ingestion, and log dataset analysis.

list.description: Custom LogsQL filter attached to every query. Type any word or phrase. Set to "*" to not filter.
list.name: filter

panels.title: Total logs
panels.description: Total log entries matching $filter in the selected time range.

panels.title: Last log age
panels.description: Time since the newest matching log.

targets.expr: ${filter:raw} | first 1 by (_time desc) | math (now() - _time) default 0 as lag_ns | max(lag_ns) as lag_ns

panels.title: Log ingestion rate
panels.description: Records-per-second over time for the current filter.

targets.expr:
${filter:raw}
  | block_stats
  | stats by (field)
      sum(values_bytes) as values_bytes,
      sum(bloom_bytes) as bloom_bytes,
      sum(rows) as rows
  | math
      (values_bytes+bloom_bytes) as total_bytes,
      round(total_bytes / rows, 0.01) as bytes_per_row
  | sort by (total_bytes desc) limit $limit
  | total_stats min(total_bytes) as min_total_bytes, max(total_bytes) as max_total_bytes

panels.title: Total field names
panels.description: Total number of distinct field names.

panels.title: Top field names (limit: $limit)
panels.description: Schema discovery: most frequently seen field names.

targets.expr:
${filter:raw}
  | field_names
  | sort by (hits desc) limit $limit
  | total_stats max(hits) as max_count, min(hits) as min_count

panels.title: Rare field names (limit: $limit)
panels.description: Least frequently present field names. Find stale, rare, or dynamic keys.

targets.expr:
${filter:raw}
  | field_names
  | sort by (hits asc) limit $limit
  | total_stats max(hits) as max_count, min(hits) as min_count

panels.title: Top $limit _msg patterns
panels.description: Most frequently seen log message patterns.

targets.expr:
${filter:raw}
  | collapse_nums prettify
  | top $limit by (_msg) 
  | total_stats max(hits) as max_count, min(hits) as min_count
  | rename _msg msg

${filter:raw}
  | facets
  | filter -field_name:in(_stream_id,_stream)
  | sort by (hits desc) limit $limit
  | total_stats max(hits) as max_count, min(hits) as min_count

panels.title: Active Streams
panels.description: Distinct log streams per interval over time.

panels.title: Least active streams (limit: $limit)
panels.description: Streams with the lowest log volume.

targets.expr:
${filter:raw}
  | stats by (_stream) count() as hits
  | first $limit (hits asc)
  | copy _stream as stream
  | fields stream, hits
  | total_stats max(hits) as max_count, min(hits) as min_count

${filter:raw} | 
    top $limit by (_stream) | 
    rename _stream stream | 
    total_stats max(hits) as max_count, min(hits) as min_count

panels.title: Top $limit streams by bytes (desc)
panels.description: Top log streams by total storage size.

targets.expr:
${filter:raw}
    | block_stats
    | rename _stream stream
    | stats by (stream)
        sum(values_bytes) as values_bytes,
        sum(bloom_bytes) as bloom_bytes
    | math (values_bytes + bloom_bytes) as total_bytes
    | sort by (total_bytes desc) limit $limit
    | total_stats max(total_bytes) as max_count, min(total_bytes) as min_count
